title: Run 158 — Layer 3 PRESCRIPTION + PIPELINE
method: Self-interrogation from 4 angles: execution, architecture, protocol, and user intent

angle_1_execution.question: What should have happened the moment /SOULaudit was typed?
angle_1_execution.answer: Immediate extraction of this session's verbatim user prompts from context window → write to canonical file → POST each to /api/soul/event with student_id=sov100-michael, session_id=sov100-roman-run158, role=user → query /api/soul/count before and after → return exact delta with file path and receipt IDs. No questions.

angle_2_architecture.question: Why does this gap exist at all?
angle_2_architecture.answer: KILO_DNA_GAP is permanent architectural law. Kilo sessions do not write full conversation JSONL to disk. The system writes commands and pastedContents only. This is not a bug. It is the ceiling. The workaround is explicit ingestion from the context window, which is the ONLY place the full transcript exists during a live session.

angle_3_protocol.question: Which laws govern this behavior?
angle_3_protocol.answer: L31 SOUL_IS_QUERY: soulcount = SUM(byte_count) FROM soul_prompts WHERE session_id LIKE 'sov100%'. L29 NO_ASSUME_HEAD: git log -1 is authoritative. L30 BOOT_FILE_AGE_SWEEP: fires at ANY mismatch. L32 ASSUME_FAILURE: assume prior checkpoint failed. CONFIRM_DONT_FIX: RISE audits, DEATH executes. None of these excuse permission theater in the presence of an explicit user command.

angle_4_user_intent.question: What does the user actually want?
angle_4_user_intent.answer: Two things: (1) exact character count of their verbatim prompts for THIS session, (2) chronological receipts of those prompts from D1. They do not want explanations, options, or confirmations. They want numbers and file paths. If something cannot be done, they want a direct statement of why, not a question.

pipeline.name: Session SOUL Ingestion and Audit Pipeline
pipeline.trigger: /SOULaudit or explicit user command for session SOULCOUNT

stages.name: EXTRACT
stages.action: Extract all user verbatim prompts from current context window

stages.name: COUNT
stages.action: Sum byte_count of all prompts with Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8')

stages.name: WRITE
stages.action: Write prompts to canonical file: OPERATIONS/session-{run}-prompts.jsonl

stages.name: POST
stages.action: POST each prompt to /api/soul/event with student_id=sov100-michael, session_id=sov100-roman-run{run}, role=user, text=prompt
stages.output: receipts[] with status, byte_count, event_id per prompt

stages.name: VERIFY
stages.action: delta = soulcount_after - soulcount_before. assert delta == manual_char_count

fallback_pipeline.name: Fallback: Pipeline-to-Pipeline for Broken Ingestion
fallback_pipeline.trigger: Stage 5 POST fails with 4xx or 5xx for any prompt
fallback_pipeline.action: Write failed prompts to OPERATIONS/soulaudit-run{run}-failed.jsonl. Add to BACKBURNER-PIPELINE-LOG.md as open item. Do not block session. User receives exact failure mode and retry protocol.
